BiblicalUsage: En-Eglajim is a place in Palestine. The name appears in Ezekiel (Ezekiel 47:10). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Eglajim matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Eglajim is one of them.
